context.package.json:
{
  "name": "magic-canvas",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.29.2",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24.0.0 <25"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "postinstall": "node scripts/prepare-native.mjs",
    "dev": "pnpm build && electron apps/desktop",
    "check": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "tsx --test tests/*.test.ts",
    "test:budgets": "tsx --test tests/perf/budgets.test.ts",
    "build": "pnpm check && tsx scripts/build.ts",
    "gateway": "node --env-file-if-exists=apps/gateway/.env --import tsx apps/gateway/src/index.ts",
    "fixture": "tsx scripts/inspect-fixture.ts",
    "preview": "tsx scripts/preview.ts",
    "test:desktop": "pnpm build && tsx scripts/desktop-smoke.ts",
    "test:e2e": "tsx scripts/build.ts && tsx --test --test-reporter=spec tests/e2e/*.e2e.ts",
    "test:e2e:real": "tsx scripts/build.ts && tsx --test --test-reporter=spec tests/e2e/real/real-clients.real.ts",
    "magic:perf": "tsx evals/perf/run.ts",
    "eval:items": "tsx evals/items/run.ts"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "24.10.1",
    "@types/react": "19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "19.3.0",
    "electron": "44.4.5",
    "esbuild": "0.27.0",
    "playwright": "1.63.0",
    "tsx": "4.20.6",
    "typescript": "5.9.3",
    "vite": "8.3.1"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@azure/msal-node": "7.0.0",
    "@hugeicons/core-free-icons": "4.3.5",
    "@hugeicons/react": "1.1.10",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/client": "2.1.0",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/server": "2.1.0",
    "@xterm/addon-fit": "0.11.0",
    "@xterm/xterm": "6.0.0",
    "docx": "9.7.2",
    "katex": "0.18.9",
    "mammoth": "1.13.0",
    "mathjs": "15.2.0",
    "node-pty": "1.1.0",
    "pdfjs-dist": "6.3.289",
    "react": "19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "19.3.0",
    "ts-fsrs": "5.4.2",
    "zod": "4.6.5"
  }
}
context.pnpm-workspace.yaml:
packages:
  - apps/*
  - packages/*
onlyBuiltDependencies:
  - electron
  - esbuild
context.tsconfig.json:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2023",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "Bundler",
    "strict": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "types": ["node"],
    "lib": ["ES2023", "DOM"],
    "baseUrl": ".",
    "paths": {
      "@magic/contracts": ["packages/contracts/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/domain": ["packages/domain/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/core": ["packages/core/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/storage": ["packages/storage/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/connectors": ["packages/connectors/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/ai": ["packages/ai/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/learning": ["packages/learning/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/runner": ["packages/runner/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/packs": ["packages/packs/core/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/retrieval": ["packages/retrieval/src/index.ts"],
      "@magic/agent-api": ["packages/agent-api/src/index.ts"]
    },
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true
  },
  "include": [
    "packages/**/*.ts",
    "apps/**/*.ts",
    "apps/**/*.tsx",
    "scripts/**/*.ts",
    "tests/**/*.ts",
    "evals/**/*.ts",
    "api/**/*.ts"
  ],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "**/dist/**"]
}
